messages:
anya: Quick heads up — aiming to run a tf apply for IAM session-duration+role-expiry tweaks in the 20:00 UTC change window. Need deploybot lock and provider version pining before we start.

sam: ack. which provider pin? and any service account rotations included?

anya: pinning aws provider to 4.12.0 for this run (we saw drift with 4.13 in staging). no SA rotations this change, just adjust assume-role durations and add explicit tag on the role.

mike: +1 on pin. Can we throttle the apply (serial across regions) — don't want a simultaneous rollout hitting control-plane quotas.

liz: logging a preflight checklist: 1) infra lock via deploybot 2) tf plan uploaded to artifacts 3) canary region apply 4) health-check hook on auth service 5) rollback playbook ready

deploybot: deploybot: Queued apply request from anya (2151234567). Current lock state: unlocked. To acquire lock run: `deploybot lock infra-apply-2151234567 --owner anya --window 20:00-21:00Z`.

anya: locking now, running command.

deploybot: deploybot: Lock acquired by anya. TTL 75 minutes. Release with `deploybot unlock infra-apply-2151234567`. :lock: :white_check_mark:

infra-oncall-bot: infra-oncall-bot: Notifying oncall and posting preflight summary: /ops/alerts channel. If rollback signal observed, tag `rollback-needed` on the run.

sam: Plan looks clean. Suggest we set apply concurrency to `serial` and `target` the IAM modules first. Example apply command:```bash
terraform apply -parallelism=1 -target=module.iam_roles -auto-approve
```

mike: agree. After iam apply, wait 5m and run smoke auth checks: `curl -f https://auth.canary.<region>.redwood.ai/health || exit 1`

anya: note on rollback criteria: any increase in 5xx rate >1% or auth latency p95 regressed >200ms triggers rollback. We'll use the `rollback-needed` tag to signal.

liz: manual rollback runbook (short):
1) Add `rollback-needed` tag to deploybot run: `deploybot tag 2151234567 rollback-needed`
2) Lock further applies: `deploybot lock infra-rollback-2151234567 --owner oncall`
3) Revert commit in infra repo and create emergency release branch `revert/2151234567`
4) Run tf apply of previous state (provider pin preserved):```bash
git checkout revert/2151234567
terraform init -upgrade=false
terraform apply -auto-approve
```
5) If state divergence occurs, escalate to state-ops: `terraform state rm <problem_resource>` then re-apply targeted revert.
6) Postmortem and deployment freeze for 2 hours.

sam: add one more: notify identity team and rotate any short-lived credentials if we had role-duration misconfig.

anya: during canary we've added a temporary KV-cache bypass in front of auth to avoid stale tokens. Will revert after validation.

mike: ETA for plan -> apply? I can be on standby at 19:45 UTC.

anya: plan uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/infra/plans/2151234567-plan.txt. Please review.

liz: approved. I'll monitor metrics and runbook steps. If anything odd, I will tag rollback-needed and call oncall. :eyes:

deploybot: deploybot: Starting canary apply in `us-west-2-canary` in 5m. Will honor concurrency=1 and provider pin. Streaming plan: https://deploybot.redwood.ai/runs/2151234567

infra-oncall-bot: infra-oncall-bot: Reminder: emergency contact list pinned in thread. Oncall is sam for this window.

mike: standing by. If we need to force revert, I have access to the state bucket and can run state restores.

anya: thanks team — will proceed at 20:00 UTC. Keep chatter here for any rollback signals.

liz: :thumbsup:

deploybot: deploybot: Canary apply completed in us-west-2-canary. No failures. Monitoring for 10m.

(10 minutes pass)

liz: metrics look stable, p95 auth down by 30ms, 5xx unchanged. Proceed with staged apply to eu-west-1.

deploybot: deploybot: Staged apply started in eu-west-1.

mike: saw a spike in auth 502s in eu-west-1 at +0.9% — within threshold but keep eyes on it.

liz: monitoring, still within threshold. Oncall, want to continue?

sam: continue. If it reaches 1.0% then tag rollback-needed and I'll initiate revert.

(brief)

deploybot: deploybot: Staged apply completed across remaining regions. No rollback tag present. Releasing lock.

deploybot: deploybot: Lock released by anya. Run summary and artifacts: https://deploybot.redwood.ai/runs/2151234567/summary

anya: great run, thanks. Will follow up with a short release note and add the provider pin to the repo's release notes.

liz: adding to changelog and scheduling a 1-day watch.

sam: closing this thread — good deployment. :party_popper:
